questions.question: Which three science and engineering broad fields awarded the highest number of doctorates in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1–6', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[3]
col_2023 = header_row[header_row.astype(str).str.strip() == '2023'].index[0]

fields = [
    'Agricultural sciences and natural resources',
    'Biological and biomedical sciences',
    'Computer and information sciences',
    'Engineering',
    'Geosciences, atmospheric, and ocean sciences',
    'Health sciences',
    'Mathematics and statistics',
    'Physical sciences',
    'Psychology',
    'Social sciences'
]

totals = {}
for f in fields:
    row_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == f].index[0]
    totals[f] = float(df.iloc[row_idx, col_2023])

sorted_fields = sorted(totals.keys(), key=lambda k: totals[k], reverse=True)
result = sorted_fields[:3]

questions.question: In which surveyed year did the number of doctorates awarded in education reach its highest level?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1–6', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[3]
years = [str(x).strip().replace('.0', '') for x in header_row[1:11]]
edu_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Education'].index[0]
edu_vals = [float(df.iloc[edu_idx, c]) for c in range(1, 11)]
max_idx = edu_vals.index(max(edu_vals))
result = years[max_idx]

questions.question: What was the average annual number of doctorates awarded in computer and information sciences across the 10 surveyed years from 1978 to 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1–6', header=None)
cis_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Computer and information sciences'].index[0]
vals = [float(df.iloc[cis_idx, c]) for c in range(1, 11)]

questions.question: In which surveyed year were the fewest doctorates awarded in humanities and arts?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1–6', header=None)
header_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Field and citizenship status', na=False)].index[0]
years = [str(int(x)) if isinstance(x, (int, float)) else str(x).strip() for x in df.iloc[header_idx, 1:].values]
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Humanities and arts'].iloc[0, 1:].values
series = pd.Series(row, index=years).astype(int)
result = series.idxmin()

questions.question: Which two non-science and engineering fields awarded the highest number of doctorates in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name='Table 1–6', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Field and citizenship status', na=False)].iloc[0]
col_idx = header_row[header_row.astype(str).str.contains('2023')].index[0]
fields = ['Business', 'Education', 'Humanities and arts', 'Other non-science and engineering']
sub_df = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(fields)]
top2 = sub_df.sort_values(by=col_idx, ascending=False).head(2)
result = top2[0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: In 1978, were more doctorates conferred in psychology than in humanities and arts?
